appliesTo.quote: Numbers below follow the [Stardew Valley Wiki](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Stardew_Valley_Wiki) computer version **1.6.15**.
[Farming](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Farming) is the skill tied to planting, growing, and harvesting crops, and to the care of farm animals.

To level the skill you need experience points, which are gained by harvesting crops, petting farm animals, milking cows or goats, shearing sheep, picking up animal products inside a coop, or reading the Stardew Valley Almanac or Book Of Stars.
Harvesting with a scythe also grants Farming XP on the current page; the same history notes a 1.3.27 fix for a bug that blocked that grant.

More expensive crops give more experience on harvest. Crops with multiple harvests give experience for every harvest. Crops that yield several items in one harvest, such as blueberry, cranberry, or potato, only reward experience for the first product and do not offer any extra experience for the multiples.
High-quality crops grant the same amount of XP as normal-quality crops.
`XP = ||16 × ln(0.018 × PRICE + 1)||`, where PRICE is the crop’s base sell price.
from level 0 to 1 it takes 13 parsnips, or 8 potatoes, or 5 cauliflowers. From level 0 to 2, it takes about 48 parsnips, or 28 potatoes, or 17 cauliflowers.
using a hoe or watering can does not grant experience by itself.
Each Farming level also grants +1 proficiency to hoes and watering cans.
The cumulative XP to stand on each level is 100, 380, 770, 1,300, 2,150, 3,300, 4,800, 6,900, 10,000, and 15,000.
The first time you level a skill on a given day, the game notifies you with “You've got some new ideas to sleep on.”
Items sold or shipped the day of the increase do not receive the new price bonuses.
